Construction: ENGINEERING + SOFTWARE + NAME + CENTRAL LOTUS in ONE compact LOW DOUBLE-SUPPORT EMBLEM. Two broad side supports derive from TWO 木 branching columns of 林, sharing ONE structural lower beam. Their inside edges carve out a VERY CLEAR THREE-PETAL LOTUS in pure WHITE NEGATIVE SPACE EXACTLY IN THE CENTER. The petal outlines ARE the inner edges of the engineered supports, not a flower sticker added to a frame. A small left square dot and open right hooked beam end recall 礼. Large clear openings and 5-6 solids maximum. Wide balanced low silhouette, no roof or pagoda. Palette: Deep navy left support, violet-blue right support, warm orange shared beam. White central lotus. Flat professional vector-like geometry, crisp contours, medium optical weight and generous white gaps. ONE centered emblem on PURE WHITE with generous margins. NO rendered company text or captions; a neutral exact company wordmark will be added separately for consistent comparison. No gear, helmet, crane, skyscraper, laptop, phone, circuit-board detail, 3D, shadow, gloss, textured mockup, decorative explanation arrows or copied brand. Do not make the name into two independent printed words.
